invariants.rule: Todo Orchestrator remains the sole Todo transaction authority; Project Control does not write SQLite or copy plan, dependency, lifecycle, or transaction semantics.
The observer profile remains project-read-only with its existing tool names, schemas, accepted calls, and semantics and exposes no mutation switch or dormant mutator.
The Codex profile retains its established six workflow tools and existing rich reads without broad plan mutation.
Broad plan mutation is available only through the explicit trusted startup-selected mutator profile and never through client metadata, tool arguments, model claims, or annotations.
ProposalEnvelope remains inert with authority_to_apply false; only a fresh validated proposal consumed by the trusted mutator profile may reach Todo authority.
Plan application re-observes complete relevant preconditions and rejects staleness without guessing, rebasing, regeneration, or retry.
V1 compiles and applies one explicit repository authority at a time and reports cross-authority dependencies without translating them into local Todo dependencies.
The native Todo Orchestrator plan is the canonical v1 mutation representation; pre-ledger input is only a deterministic frontend.
Project Control never invokes another MCP server to implement plan mutation.
No downstream project is mutated by this implementation or its large-package compile-only smoke test.

tasks.title: Freeze live mutation-ingest contract and baseline
tasks.objective: Record the live Project Control and Todo authority baseline and freeze the narrow v1 pre-ledger, native-plan, proposal, freshness, profile, and receipt contract.

tasks.title: Implement pre-ledger package compiler
tasks.objective: Compile versioned or compatibility pre-ledger packages deterministically into supported native Todo plans for one selected repository authority, preserving bounded provenance and reporting cross-authority dependencies.

tasks.title: Implement validated Todo plan mutation service
tasks.objective: Add one Project Control service that validates proposal digest and freshness, delegates native plan validate/diff/apply to the verified Todo runtime, applies once, verifies authority continuity, and returns a bounded receipt.

tasks.title: Add bulk plan CLI
tasks.objective: Add plan compile, validate, and apply commands; compile never mutates and apply constructs an inert fresh proposal then uses the shared mutation service.

tasks.title: Add explicit mutator MCP profile and apply_plan tool
tasks.objective: Add a stdio-only trusted mutator profile with the existing Codex workflow and rich-read tools plus apply_plan, using the shared mutation service without filesystem, shell, force, or stale-recovery authority.

tasks.title: Integrate tests, documentation, and release contract
tasks.objective: Integrate the bounded compiler, mutation service, CLI, and mutator profile; prove observer and Codex compatibility, run the relevant and full unit suites, document v1, smoke compile any accessible large package, commit, and push.

charter.objective: Deliver the first bounded Project Control bulk-ledger compiler and general native Todo plan write surface.
boundaries: No Project Control or Todo redesign.
acceptance_conditions: Native plan mutation delegates to Todo authority.
Local CLI compile, validate, and apply work.
Observer and Codex contracts remain compatible.
